---
name: forbidden-ai-tells
description: Named patterns banned in UI and copy — LILA BAN, Jane Doe, Acme Slop, Filler Word Index, Pure Black, Icon Soup, etc.
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Output that betrays "generated without judgment" is banned. Each tell has a name
so it can be called out: LILA BAN (generic AI purple/blue), Jane Doe Effect
(generic names/avatars), Acme Slop (invented generic brands), Filler Word Index
(Elevate/Unleash/Seamless/Next-gen), 99.99% Problem (predictable demo numbers),
Pure Black Tell (never pure `#000`), Inter Tell (generic default sans), Icon
Soup (no icon budget), Mobile Afterthought (shrunk-desktop), Layout Shift Sloppy
(CLS > 0.05).

**Why:** These patterns make work look machine-generated and lower perceived
quality. Real names make them easy to flag in review.

**How to apply:** In any UI or copy, swap filler words for a concrete verb +
specific outcome, use real names and messy numbers (Data Realism), respect the
icon budget, and keep CLS under 0.05. Pairs with [[foundation-first-frontend]].
